_template: SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY — DO NOT WRITE THIS DOCUMENT TO THE STORE. Field names and clamps were read out of the Command Deck renderer (renderCliConnectors, command-deck.html ~26953-27081), not from prose. With NO document the card says 'No cliAnythingStatus document has ever been written, so nothing has ever checked any of these on your Mac' — which is true today. The moment any document exists with a checkedAt, the card instead says 'The cliAnythingStatus document says CLI-Anything is NOT installed (checked <time>)', asserting that something inspected Steven's Mac at that time. Nothing has, and no cloud session can. So this file is a template for the Mac task in routines/mac-task-repairs.md section 9 to fill by actually looking; every value below is a placeholder in <angle brackets> or an explicitly-marked default. Honest current state, 2026-09-22: CLI-Anything was installed and exercised ONCE in a throwaway cloud sandbox that dies with its container — that proves the toolchain and changes nothing on Steven's machine — and the seven read-only harness packages are pre-built in integrations/cli-anything-harnesses/, installed by MAC-SETUP.sh --only cli-anything-harnesses, never yet run on the Mac and never run live anywhere.
_fields: Top level the page reads: installed (=== true), checkedAt, hubVersion, wrappers[], note. Per wrapper: name, target, connState, status, readOnly, verbsEnabled[], lastRun, lastCheckedAt, eccReviewedAt, error, action. A wrapper is matched to a card row by SUBSTRING of the row key in its target or name: homes, showingtime, showami, skyslope, zipforms, lofty. The page owns the row list — it has six rows and no Zoho row, so the zoho entry below is ignored until the card gains one; a document can change what a row says but can never add, remove or blank a row.
_clamps: connState wins if it is one of not-installed | installed-untested | read-only-live | error | disabled-by-policy; otherwise a non-empty error string reads error, otherwise status is derived (failed->error; enabled WITH lastRun->read-only-live; enabled|tested|generated->installed-untested; planned->disabled-by-policy if the row is gated else not-installed). Then three clamps fire: read-only-live without a lastRun drops to installed-untested; a gated row (SkySlope, zipForms) claiming read-only-live without an eccReviewedAt drops to disabled-by-policy; readOnly:false becomes error. TRIPWIRE: every string in verbsEnabled is tested against /(\bact\b|request|confirm|cancel|reschedul|post|accept|assign|book|hire|send|submit|sign|upload|delete|creat|updat|fill|pay|invit|messag|click|type)/i and a single match turns that row AND the whole card red with 'WRITE VERB ENABLED'. List verb GROUPS the harness actually exposes, never recipe names — Showami's read recipes my-requests, request-status and posted-price all match that pattern and would raise a false alarm (see F-P2-15). Only the first 8 strings are shown.
